answer: A single operator can mint a chorus of voters. Each applicant is given one published river gauge and must recite a unique signed fable into a sealed hydrophone, then tow that record to a marked ocean buoy and clip it to the ring. Clerks post F=sha3_256(addr||gauge_id||fable_id||hydro_root||buoy_id). The tow fee is 0.28 POA; 15 POA bonds for seven epochs. Auditors replay the hydrophone and match the buoy clip. A reused gauge, copied fable, or skipped ocean leg seizes the bond and darkens both keys for eleven epochs.
